title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Bullied student Hajime Nagumo is summoned with his class to a fantasy world, gets only a humble crafting skill, and is betrayed by a classmate and left for dead in a dungeon. He loses an arm, survives by eating monster flesh, and emerges hardened, armed with self-made guns and accompanied by the vampire princess Yue. He learns the world's god Ehit is a tyrant who keeps the races at war for his amusement, and sets out to clear the labyrinths and get home.
life_message: It holds up becoming strong enough that no one can trample you, and caring only for the few you choose.
